name: Eagle Creek Orchard
tagline: Eagle Creek Orchard — Fruit in Richland, OR
description: Eagle Creek Orchard grows Apricots and Cherries in Richland, OR. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
